$comment: Equal Earth projection constants (Savric, Patterson & Jenny 2018, DOI 10.1080/13658816.2018.1504949). Spherical forward equations (R=1, lambda0=0): theta = asin(M sin phi); y = F(theta) = A1*theta + A2*theta^3 + A3*theta^7 + A4*theta^9; x = lambda*cos(theta)/(M*F'(theta)), F'(theta) = A1 + 3*A2*theta^2 + 7*A3*theta^6 + 9*A4*theta^8. A2 is NEGATIVE (a misprint on one equal-earth.com PDF shows +0.081106; the paper, Wikipedia, and PROJ eqearth.cpp all confirm the negative sign).
name: Equal Earth

referencePoints.note: Exact from formula: pi/(M*A1) = 2.7066299837...; antimeridian half-width

validation.inverse: Newton-Raphson on y to recover theta, then lambda = M*x*F'(theta)/cos(theta), phi = asin(sin(theta)/M). Reference: PROJ eqearth.cpp (<=12 iterations, tol 1e-11).
